name: SuperMemory
ontology_notes: Documents (raw ingest) vs memories (extracted facts) vs user profiles (static + dynamic) vs SuperRAG chunks. Memory relations are updates, extends, derives. Isolation is containerTag (user, project, org, or anything). No character autobiography or relationship-state type. Profile is one bag per containerTag.

ontology.evidence: docs/concepts/how-it-works.md and graph-memory.md: documents vs memories vs graph edges. user-profiles.md: static and dynamic profile per containerTag. Graph memory types in the table are Facts, Preferences, Episodes. Companion roles are not types.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: client.add sends raw content under containerTag. learner-1 / dreaming extracts facts. dreaming=dynamic (default) groups related docs; instant dreams one doc now. MCP memory tool lets the model save or forget. No documented refusal of intimate text.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: client.search is hybrid RAG + memory. client.profile returns always-on static/dynamic facts (~50ms) plus optional search. MCP recall and /context inject the profile. Search can return no hits; the profile still injects if the app calls it.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: graph-memory.md Updates: new fact replaces the old for search; history can remain; isLatest marks current. Extends adds detail. Contradiction: updates win for what is true now.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: README and graph-memory.md: temporal vector-graph, time-based expiry of temporary facts, knowledge-update handling. LongMemEval category scores include Temporal Reasoning 91%.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: containerTag is one namespace. user-profiles.md: a profile can be a user, agent, or organization. There is no user vs character vs relationship split unless the app invents multiple tags.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Search ranks by relevance. Profile is designed to always ride along, including name and tone prefs. No skip of a relevant memory for social reasons.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: graph-memory.md noise filtering says casual chatter is less likely to become durable memory. Derives can be reviewed as low-confidence. No trust tags. MCP write is model-initiated.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: Automatic forgetting: time-based expiry, contradiction updates, noise filter. README MCP memory tool save or forget. Forget & update docs are linked from graph-memory.md.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Add queues extract/chunk/embed/index then dreaming (extra operation if instant). profile() is one cheap call. search is hybrid. LongMemEval claim: 95% Recall@15 with ~720 tokens, 99.4% context reduction. Cloud bills operations; self-host is a local binary.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: MIT. README self-host: single binary, local embeddings, API on localhost:6767, including offline. Managed cloud is the other path.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Official https://mcp.supermemory.ai/mcp. README tools memory, recall, context. Source under apps/mcp. Requires a Supermemory account for the hosted URL; OSS MCP lives in the repo.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Profiles plus temporal updates/forgetting are useful for a long-lived person. The unit of isolation is still one containerTag bag. No character vs relationship ontology and no silence. The product loop is extract, then profile/search into the prompt.

published_eval.name: LongMemEval, LoCoMo, ConvoMem
published_eval.claimed_score: README claims #1 on all three. LongMemEval 95% Recall@15 at ~720 tokens (99.4% context reduction). Category recall: Knowledge Updates 99%, Assistant 100%, User 97%, Multi-session 93%, Temporal 91%, Preference 90%.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Long-horizon assistant memory QA, fact recall, and preference learning. Not character identity drift, socially wrong recall, or persona poisoning.

open_unknowns: Whether the self-host binary includes dreaming/learner-1 or only search/profiles.
Exact hosted vs OSS feature split for forget and memory review.
How ConvoMem #1 was measured (model, split) beyond the README badge.
